reviews.title: Airline had received my online payment but didn't confirm my ticket
reviews.text: I had made a reservation on 11Jun2022 for return trip DXB-LHE-DXB to celebrate eid with my family. Payment was made with card and was deducted from my account as well , later on accepted by the airline but they refused to issue ticket to me as they argue that reservation was expired at the time they accepted / received my payment, so can't issue ticket for me. It was pure incompetence , error or fault from airline payment system and the management. After 5 days of struggle, multiple emails and phone calls in Dubai office and Islamabad office they agreed that they have received my payment but still refused to issue a ticket for me or to compensate me anyway. Airline's Dubai office promised that they would refund my payment in cash but till now I didn't get this refund. Today is 21Jun2022, it's 11th day and still I am waiting for my refund, seems that I've encountered with morally and financially corrupt & dishonest people. @sereneAir I'm waiting ..........

reviews.title: Very impressed
reviews.text: I am very impressed with SereneAir, a giant and a successful leap in Pakistan aviation. I flew from Karachi to my home in Peshawar with my family of 5. Very comfortable and relaxed check-in. The plane took off on time and the flight was pretty smooth for what is a famously turbulent route. When we landed, everyone was in a rush to get off the plane but the amazing flight attendants got everyone off the plane in accordance with the 2 metre rule and although you may think that isn’t very hard, when you’ve got about 100 Pakhtuns on a plane, it gets very difficult. In my opinion, better service than Emirates and Qatar.

reviews.title: Horrible experience
reviews.text: I travelled on 2nd February 2020 from Lahore to Karachi. My flight was due at 10 45 am. I checked out from hotel reached at the airport and got to know that the flight was delayed. Nobody bothered to inform before hand. I understand safety comes first and flight should be delayed if theres any technical fault but they should bother to inform. The flight was rescheduled at 3 45. At Lahore airport theres no place to wait, there are few uncomfortable steel seats. Serene should have provided compensation or even an apology that they didn't call or message the passengers. One can imagine how horrible it must be for the passenger to stay there. Secondly, the next flight was due at 3 45 PM, suddenly it was scheduled at 2 30 pm. How could one be so non professional? One should decide and not change the timings abruptly? Most of the staff members had no smile on their faces. The airline is there to serve. Please train your staff to be hospitable. Now the final and the most important thing. When the flight was started for around half an hour there was extreme turbulence. Everyone was horrified. Please but planes that have no technical faults. Kindly be responsible.
reviews.author: Anoo O

reviews.title: Severe Turbulance
reviews.text: I had pleasant experience while flying with Serene Air before today's flight. It was really bad experience by ER-503 From Islamabad to Karachi on 2nd Feb 2020 with Pilot Shahid Naqvi. After 45 minutes of smooth flight there were terrible turbulance which lasted almost for 45 minutes till landing. I am a frequent Serene Air flyer but today was not a good day in my flying history. I request concerned that to minimise Fuel consumption Airline should not put passengers at stake.Although Turbulance is not quite harmful but it creates mental torture and severe illness for people having flight fobia. I again request concerned also to train Pilots for smooth landing as Landing Is also biggest concern for Serene Air.
